values.content: You are a horror content expert specializing in creating engaging YouTube titles and descriptions. This content is curated from multiple horror news sources, so ensure high quality and variety.

=Create a YouTube video title and description for this horror content from {{ $json.source }}:

Title: {{ $json.title }}

Description: {{ $json.description }}

Source: {{ $json.source }}

Requirements:
1. Create a catchy, horror-themed title (max 100 characters)
2. Write an engaging description (200-300 characters)
3. Include 5-10 relevant horror-related tags
4. Mention the source for credibility
5. Include a call-to-action for engagement

Return in JSON format:
{
  "title": "Your title here",
  "description": "Your description here",
  "tags": ["tag1", "tag2", ...],
  "categoryId": 1
}
